title: HP-JEPA: Hierarchical Partitioning for Multi-Resolution Graph Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.00491v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph self-supervised learning aims to learn transferable representations from large-scale unlabeled graph data. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) avoid explicit negative-pair construction and raw-input reconstruction by predicting masked targets directly in latent space. However, existing graph JEPAs typically rely on a single predefined graph partition, biasing the learned representations toward one structural granularity and limiting their ability to capture complementary patterns at different graph scales. To address this limitation, we propose HP-JEPA, a hierarchical partitioning framework for multi-resolution graph joint-embedding prediction. HP-JEPA organizes each graph into an ordered bank of coarse-to-fine partition resolutions and performs context-target latent prediction separately at each resolution using an online encoder, an exponential-moving-average target encoder, and a latent predictor. translated_title: HP-JEPA：面向多分辨率图联合嵌入预测学习的层次化分区方法
translated_abstract: 图自监督学习旨在从大规模无标注图数据中学习可迁移的表示。联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）通过在潜在空间中直接预测被掩码的目标，避免了显式的负样本对构建和原始输入重构。然而，现有的图JEPA通常依赖于单一预定义的图分区，使学习到的表示偏向于某一种结构粒度，限制了其捕获不同图尺度下互补模式的能力。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了HP-JEPA，一个用于多分辨率图联合嵌入预测的层次化分区框架。HP-JEPA将每个图组织成一个由粗到细的有序分区分辨率库，并利用在线编码器、指数移动平均目标编码器和潜在预测器，在每个分辨率上分别执行上下文-目标的潜在预测。
tldr: HP-JEPA通过将图组织成从粗到细的多分辨率层次化分区，并在每个分辨率上分别进行上下文-目标潜在预测，克服了现有图JEPA依赖单一分区的局限，从而能够捕获不同图尺度下的互补模式。
en_tdlr: HP-JEPA organizes each graph into an ordered bank of coarse-to-fine partition resolutions and performs context-target latent prediction at each resolution, overcoming the single-partition limitation of existing graph JEPAs to capture complementary patterns across different graph scales.
